corridors.name: I-10 corridor
corridors.summary: Casa Grande → Maricopa → Buckeye → Tonopah → I-10 shoulder → Quartzsite → Blythe → I-10 shoulder → Desert Center → Chiriaco Summit → Indio → Palm Springs → San Gorgonio Pass → Banning → Redlands → Pacific Electric Trail → Pasadena → the Elysian.

corridors.name: I-10 variant: Salome Hwy and US 60 (off the interstate)
corridors.summary: Tonopah → Salome Highway → Harquahala Valley → Salome → Hope → Brenda → back on I-10 to Quartzsite. Longer than the interstate, but it passes three small towns with RV parks.

corridors.name: I-10 variant: Box Canyon to Mecca (off the interstate)
corridors.summary: Leave I-10 below Chiriaco Summit, drop down Box Canyon Road to Mecca at the top of the Salton Sea, then ride the CV Link path into Indio.

corridors.name: I-8 corridor (the route in the app)
corridors.summary: The app’s own line: Casa Grande → Gila Bend → Dateland → Wellton → Yuma → El Centro → In-Ko-Pah grade → Jacumba → Alpine → San Diego → the coast → Long Beach, then up the LA River path to the Elysian (skipping the Santa Monica Pier saves about 23 mi).

corridors.name: Hybrid: I-8 to El Centro, Salton Sea, then I-10 corridor
corridors.summary: Keep the I-8 line (and its dense camps) as far as El Centro, then ride CA 111 up the east shore of the Salton Sea to Mecca and Indio, and finish on the I-10 corridor. Skips the San Diego mountains.
